substeps.caption: A floor frame set up for unattended tests, as in Instron's AT6 and AT3 cells: a printed tensile specimen in hydraulic wedge grips, inside a 3119-608 chamber (to 600 C) on pull rods.
Its left-hinged door has a heated triple-pane window: the AVE 2 video extensometer reads the strain through it, so no clip-on extensometer goes on by hand.
It heats the grips and the specimen to the test temperature; then the pull.
Broken. The halves go down the scrap chute, right of the grips (the AT6 drops them into angled steel chutes).
